entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member, born Kytheon Iora on Theros, who is overwhelmed by meeting the god Oketra.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who reads minds to improvise cover stories and creates an opening in the Hekma.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who wants to help a fleeing woman and questions Gideon's trust in Oketra.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who calms Gideon and helps Jace open the barrier.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who charms Temmet and delights in the city's use of the dead.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who warned the group about Bolas's power.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker revered by the people of the city as the absent God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: A poised young Naktamun official of about sixteen who guides the group and houses them.

entities.name: Vizier Eknet
entities.description: An aven vizier of the Hekma Guard who repairs the barrier and is bluffed by Jace.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A cat-headed god of solidarity and order who trains children and recognizes Gideon as one of hers.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A Theros god who once invited young Gideon to be his champion.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of death who destroyed Gideon's Irregulars.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who judges the Trial of Strength.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet whose viziers pursue the fleeing woman.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet named by Jace in his cover story.

entities.name: The fleeing woman
entities.description: A woman captured after shouting that the trials, the gods and the hours are lies and that the return will bring devastation.

entities.name: Gideon's Irregulars
entities.description: Gideon's closest friends from his youth, destroyed by Erebos.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group sworn to protect the Multiverse from threats such as Bolas.

entities.name: Hekma Guard
entities.description: Viziers who maintain the Hekma.

entities.name: Viziers of Bontu
entities.description: Soldiers including a minotaur who pursue the fleeing woman.

entities.name: The Anointed
entities.description: Mummified dead who do all the labor in the city.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane of Bolas where the city lies.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: A lush, shining city beneath a barrier on Amonkhet where the populace trains for trials.

entities.name: The Hekma
entities.description: The iridescent protective barrier over the city.

entities.name: The horns of Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Massive twin horns on the horizon beside the second sun.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Gideon's birth plane of petty gods.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A plane where Gideon lived and where the name Gideon stuck.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane of the group's previous mission.

entities.name: The Trial of Strength
entities.description: A trial for initiates that Rhonas judges.

entities.name: Aven of Amonkhet
entities.description: Crane-headed winged people of Naktamun.

entities.name: Sand wurms
entities.description: Desert monsters that attacked the Gatewatch.

events.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
events.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

events.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
events.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

events.summary: An aven vizier arrives to repair the barrier and questions their strange clothes; Jace reads his mind and bluffs a cover story about a faraway district.
events.quote: Well, of course, that's why I'm here in the . . . Nitin district, to teach you.

events.summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
events.quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

events.summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
events.quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

events.summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
events.quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

events.summary: Gideon meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora and says the others' fates are undecided.
events.quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.

events.summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
events.quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

events.summary: Temmet lodges them in two rooms; Gideon watches Oketra walk to her temple.
events.quote: Liliana swept into one of the rooms and closed the door without a word.

events.summary: On the balcony Gideon tells Chandra his birth name was Kytheon Iora and explains what gods are and how Oketra differs.
A woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies; soldiers including a minotaur capture her while Gideon restrains Chandra.
events.quote: "The return will bring only devastation and ruin!"

events.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
events.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

events.summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
events.quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

events.summary: Unable to sleep, Gideon seeks out Oketra at dawn, telling her he seeks her.

relations.note: She says Gideon is one of hers and calls him by his birth name.
relations.quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.
All things are ordered as the God-Pharaoh—may his return come quickly
As the Gatewatch, they had sworn an oath to protect the Multiverse

relations.note: Erebos destroyed them with a flick of the wrist.
relations.quote: The god of death, Erebos, had destroyed them with a flick of the wrist, punishing Gideon's hubris.

relations.note: Heliod invited young Gideon to become his champion.
relations.quote: invited him to become the sun god's champion
What kind of city could prosper under Bolas's reign?

relations.note: An uneasy teammate whose cooperation Gideon doubts.
relations.quote: She had pulled them out of the fire on Innistrad, no doubt.
